form.title: Request Tracker tickets
form.intro: McHarbor creates an RT ticket in the chosen queue, comments on repeats and resolves it with a closing comment when the alert recovers.
form.name: Channel name
form.instanceUrlHelp: Web root of RT, without /REST/2.0. Only https:// is accepted.
form.authTokenHelp: An auth token of the dedicated McHarbor user in RT. Encrypted at rest.
form.queueHelp: Name of the RT queue new tickets are created in.
form.dedupCfHelp: Name of the custom field that holds McHarbor's dedup key. It must be applied to the queue.
form.resolveStatusHelp: The status set when the alert recovers. It must exist in the queue's lifecycle.
form.requestorHelp: Leave blank so RT's autoreply scrips do not e-mail anyone about alerts.
form.ownerHelp: Optional RT user name set as owner on create.
form.reopenWindowHelp: Reopen a ticket resolved within this many minutes instead of creating a new one. 0 always creates a new ticket.
form.pollIntervalHelp: How often to read ticket status when the RT scrip is not installed. 0 means scrip callout only.
form.updateOnRepeatHelp: When an alert fires again while its ticket is open, add a comment to the ticket.
form.statusMapHelp: Optional JSON object mapping custom RT statuses to open, acknowledged, resolved, closed or cancelled.
form.severityMapHelp: Optional JSON object mapping critical, warning and info to RT priority numbers.
form.secretKeep: Leave blank to keep the stored value.
form.badName: Letters, digits, spaces, dots, dashes and underscores only
form.badEmail: Must be a single e-mail address
form.range: Must be a whole number between {{min}} and {{max}}

guide.title: Connect Request Tracker
guide.step1: Create a privileged RT user for McHarbor and grant it CreateTicket, ShowTicket, CommentOnTicket, ModifyTicket, SeeQueue, SeeCustomField and ModifyCustomField on the target queue.
guide.step2: Create a custom field named McHarbor Dedup Key: type Enter one value, applies to Tickets, and apply it to the target queue.
guide.step3: Sign in as the McHarbor user and create an auth token under Logged in as, Settings, Auth Tokens. Paste it here with the RT base URL and the queue name.
guide.step4: Click Test connection. McHarbor checks the queue and that the custom field is applied to it, and creates nothing.
guide.step5: For status updates, rotate this channel's inbound webhook secret. Add the secret and the inbound URL to RT_SiteConfig.d/McHarbor.pm as McHarborWebhookSecret and McHarborWebhookURL, then restart RT.
guide.step6: Create a scrip on the queue with the condition On Status Change, the action User Defined and the template Blank, and paste the custom action code shown below into its commit code. Without it, McHarbor polls open tickets.
guide.signing: The scrip signs each callout with X-McHarbor-Timestamp and X-McHarbor-Signature: sha256= followed by the hex HMAC-SHA256 of the timestamp, a dot and the body, keyed with the inbound secret. McHarbor refuses callouts older than five minutes.
